title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Thursday, 24 September 2026
description: Today: OpenAI launches cheaper GPT-6 Sol and Luna models as Xiaomi ships its own new model family; Victoria's construction corruption royal commission opens as a nationwide church-scam warning spreads; Queensland expands Adult Crime, Adult Time to 45 offences while ambulance ramping hits a 5-year low; and Multiplex is appointed to build the $2.25bn Coomera Hospital. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
